slides.title: Low energy all winter? Finds that make the boring chores smaller.
A cordless stick vacuum
slides.body: Hang it where the mess happens. No cord, no closet trip, so a quick pass actually happens.

slides.title: A soap-dispensing dish brush
slides.body: Soap is already in the handle. One less thing to grab at the sink.

slides.title: A laundry hamper on wheels
slides.body: Roll it to the machine. Carrying a heavy basket is often the step we skip.

slides.title: A visual flip timer
slides.body: Flip it, clean till it's done. Seeing time move makes 10 minutes feel doable.

slides.title: Washable mats for the door
slides.body: Snow and slush stop at the mat. Toss it in the washer when it gets grim.

slides.title: On low days, the right tool is the one with the fewest steps.
